reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Toy Car Ramp 005
materials.text: We test toy cars. The red car is fast. The blue car has a loose wheel. Put the cars at the top of the ramp. Let go when the teacher says, "Go!" Do not push them. After the test, put the red car in the box. Give the blue car to the teacher.

questions.prompt: Your friend wants to use the blue car now. You say, "____"
options: Its wheel is new and strong.
questions.explanation: A蓝车轮松应等处理；B与loose矛盾；C蓝车存在。

questions.prompt: Your friend puts a car at the bottom. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B从坡顶出发；A保持坡底违反测试安排；C鞋内不是起点。

questions.prompt: The teacher has not said "Go!" Your friend is ready. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C等口令；A禁止推车；B提前放手不符规则。

questions.prompt: The test is over. Your friend holds the red car. You say, "____"
options: Put it at the school gate.
Give it to the blue wheel.
questions.explanation: A红车测后放盒；B校门未安排；C轮子不是接收者。

questions.prompt: Your friend puts the blue car with the red car. You say, "____"
options: Give the blue car to the teacher.
questions.explanation: B蓝车交老师；A隐藏、C丢弃都不是收尾安排。

materials.title: Animal Feed Trays 005
materials.text: At the farm, the teacher gives us two trays. Carrots are for the rabbits. Corn is for the hens. The rabbit gate stays shut. We give food through the small hole. Wash the empty trays at the tap. Then put them on the shelf to dry.

questions.prompt: A friend takes corn to the rabbits. You say, "____"
options: Give the rabbits an empty tray.
questions.explanation: A兔子吃胡萝卜盘；B空盘无食物；C玉米给鸡不为兔。

questions.prompt: A friend asks, "Who gets the corn?" You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B玉米给hens；A兔子对应胡萝卜；C架子不是动物。

questions.prompt: A friend starts to open the rabbit gate. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C兔门保持关；A敞开相反；B拿门回家不合。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to throw food over the high gate. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A从小孔喂；B屋顶、C水龙头均不是给兔食物方式。

questions.prompt: The trays are clean and wet. You say, "____"
options: Put them in your bag now.
Put them on the shelf to dry.
questions.explanation: B洗后放架晾干；A装湿盘入包、C再装玉米均非指定下一步。

materials.title: Library Borrowing Order 005
materials.text:
Put the dialogue in order. The first line is fixed: 1. I would like to borrow a book.
A. Here is one about garden birds.
B. Next Friday.
C. What kind would you like?
D. Thank you. When must I bring it back?
E. A book about birds, please.
Choose a position from 2 to 6 for each line.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: C第4步给出鸟书，接第3步选鸟书；A第2步应问类别；B第3步应答类别；D第5步致谢问还期；E第6步答日期。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: E第6步回答还书日期，接问还期；A第2步问类别；B第3步选类别；C第4步递书；D第5步才问还期。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: A第2步先问想借何种书；B第3步应答鸟类；C第4步递书；D第5步问归还；E第6步给日期，都不应放本句。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: D第5步收到书后致谢并问还期；A第2步尚未选种类；B第3步应选鸟类；C第4步递书；E第6步应答日期。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: B第3步回答What kind；A第2步应先问类别；C第4步才递合适书；D第5步问还期；E第6步答日期。

materials.title: Backpack Zip Note 005
materials.text: My schoolbag has a broken zip. Dad cannot fix it before school. He puts my books in a cloth bag. My pencil case stays in the schoolbag because it fits in a small pocket. I carry both bags. At school, my teacher gives me a big clip. It keeps the cloth bag closed. I take the clip home and return it the next morning.

questions.prompt: Dad fixes the zip before school.
questions.explanation: B正确：cannot fix before school；A忽略不能及时修好。

questions.prompt: The books go into a cloth bag.
questions.explanation: A正确：Dad puts books in a cloth bag；B与物品转移相反。

questions.prompt: The pencil case is in the cloth bag.
questions.explanation: B正确：笔袋留在schoolbag小袋；A混淆两袋。

questions.prompt: The teacher gives the writer a clip.
questions.explanation: A正确：教师提供大夹；B否认给定帮助。

questions.prompt: The writer returns the clip the next morning.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句明确归还时间；B与后续行动相反。

units.title: 校园小帮手的词语分类

materials.title: Helpful Word Categories 005
materials.text: The class is making labels for a help desk. Choose the word that belongs to the named group in each question. There is one answer per group.

questions.prompt: Which word names a tool for cutting paper?
questions.explanation: A scissors剪刀用于剪纸；B carrot胡萝卜是蔬菜；C cloud云是自然物。

questions.prompt: Which word names a place for borrowing books?
questions.explanation: B library图书馆借书；A厨房做饭；C河流不是借书场所。

questions.prompt: Which word names something you wear on your head?
questions.explanation: C helmet头盔戴头上；A勺子是餐具；B袜子穿脚上。

questions.prompt: Which word names a person who can help sick people?
questions.explanation: A doctor医生是帮助病人的人；B票、C铅笔均非人。

questions.prompt: Which word names a vehicle?
questions.explanation: B bicycle自行车是交通工具；A山是地形；C毯子是生活用品。

materials.title: Class Window Message 005
materials.text: The bean plants on our classroom windowsill lean towards the light. Mia wants to turn all the pots around every hour. Our teacher says we should first keep a simple record. We draw each plant on Monday and mark which side faces the window. We turn only the pot with a blue label. The pot with a white label stays in the same place. On Friday, we will draw both plants again. The teacher asks us to give both plants the same amount of water. We must not put either pot in the dark cupboard.

questions.prompt: Which way do the plants lean?
questions.explanation: A首句向光；B柜子、C地面非倾向。

questions.prompt: What does the teacher ask the class to do first?
questions.explanation: B先记录；A只是Mia想法；C标签用于区分应保留。

questions.prompt: Which pot is turned?
questions.explanation: C仅转蓝签盆；A两盆都转、B转白签均违安排。

questions.prompt: When will the class draw the plants again?
questions.explanation: A周五再画；B每小时是未采纳想法；C时间未提。

questions.prompt: What should stay the same for both plants?
questions.explanation: B浇同样水；A两签颜色不同；C纸上画位无要求。

materials.title: Storm Window Letter 005
materials.text: Our art group had displayed paper fish on the classroom windows. We used washable paint, so the windows could be cleaned later. On Thursday, a storm was forecast. We closed the windows and moved the paper fish away from the glass. Some pupils thought the fish would be safe because they were indoors. But water sometimes came through the old frames. The next morning, the windowsill was wet. Our fish were dry on the back shelf. We took photos of the wet frames for the caretaker instead of trying to fix them ourselves. After repairs, we put the fish back. We also kept one photo to explain why we had moved the display.

questions.prompt: The art group chose paint that could be washed off.
questions.explanation: A正确：washable paint便于以后清洗；B否认材料特性。

questions.prompt: All pupils immediately agreed that the fish needed moving.
questions.explanation: B正确：some pupils认为在室内安全；A把有异议夸为全同意。

questions.prompt: Water reached the windowsill during the storm.
questions.explanation: A正确：次晨windowsill was wet，前文说明旧框渗水；B否认观察。

questions.prompt: The pupils repaired the window frames themselves.
questions.explanation: B正确：拍给caretaker而非自行修；A与instead of相反。

questions.prompt: The fish were put back after the repairs.
questions.explanation: A正确：After repairs put back；B与最终动作相反。

materials.title: Station Water Fountain 005
materials.text:
Notice: Water fountain by the north waiting area
The fountain is working again after cleaning. Please refill only drinking bottles. Do not wash lunch boxes here. Press the lower button for a small cup and the upper button for a tall bottle. There are no free cups at this fountain. If you do not have a container, staff at the information desk can direct you to the café. The water may stop for five minutes at two o’clock for a daily check. During that time, use the fountain near Platform Two. Please tell station staff if water keeps flowing after you release a button. Do not pull the metal cover open yourself.

questions.prompt: What may passengers refill here?
questions.explanation: B允许饮水瓶；A明禁洗饭盒；C花盆、D清洁桶不属于许可容器。

questions.prompt: Which button is for a tall bottle?
questions.explanation: C高瓶上按钮；B下按钮给小杯；A无同时按要求；D咖啡馆按钮非本机。

questions.prompt: What should a passenger without a container know?
options: No free cups are supplied at this fountain.
The metal cover contains free cups.
Staff will lend a lunch box.
A tall bottle is required for all water.
questions.explanation: A明确无免费杯；B盖内无杯说明；C不借饭盒；D下钮亦供小杯。

questions.prompt: Where can passengers get water during the daily check?
questions.explanation: D两点检查时用二站台附近饮水点；A开盖禁止；B清洁室、C只出站无据。

questions.prompt: What should someone do if water will not stop?
options: Wash a lunch box under it.
Hold both buttons for an hour.
questions.explanation: B报告持续流水；A明确禁开盖；C禁止洗饭盒；D无此处理办法。

materials.title: Courtesy Grammar Workshop 005
materials.text:
Complete each numbered gap using the correct form of the word in brackets. Write one word per gap.
1. Yesterday, our group ____1____ (make) a wooden sign for the repair desk.
2. Look! The volunteer is ____2____ (show) May how to hold the tool.
3. There are three ____3____ (box) under the table, not one.
4. Please walk ____4____ (slow) while you carry the glass jar.
5. This ruler is ____5____ (long) than the one in my pencil case.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use MAKE.
questions.explanation: 接受made：Yesterday要求一般过去时，make过去式不规则；make原形、makes现在单三、making分词均不构成此处过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use SHOW.
questions.explanation: 接受showing：Look与is构成正在展示的进行时；show原形、showed过去式、shows单三不能接此处is形成进行时。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use BOX.
questions.explanation: 接受boxes：three要求复数，box加es；box单数、boxs拼写错误、boxed非这里的名词复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use SLOW.
questions.explanation: 接受slowly：修饰walk用所教学规范副词；slow形容词不作本题目标副词，slower和slowest比较等级无比较或最高级条件。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: use LONG.
questions.explanation: 接受longer：than提示两尺比较；long无比较级，longest最高级条件不符，length名词不能作此处比较表语。

units.title: 校园广播里的一次更正

materials.title: School Radio Correction 005
materials.text:
The school radio reported that the winter fair had raised 3,000 yuan for new library books. After the programme, a pupil noticed that the figure included money from an earlier cake sale. The fair itself had raised 2,400 yuan. The rest came from the cake sale, which had already been reported.
The young presenters wanted to correct the number, but they disagreed about how. One suggested deleting the old recording without explanation. Another wanted to wait until nobody remembered it. Their teacher asked what a listener would need in order to understand the change.
In the next programme, the presenters stated the original number, explained the mix-up and gave the correct figure for the fair. They also added a note beside the earlier recording rather than hiding the error. A parent thanked them for making the correction easy to find. The team then added a check: whenever several events appeared on one total sheet, a second pupil would confirm which lines belonged to the story being reported.

questions.prompt: What was wrong with the first report?
options: It included money from a different event.
It used a number from another school.
questions.explanation: B把早前蛋糕义卖款加进本次fair；A仍有2400；C图书馆未关闭；D非他校数据。

questions.prompt: How much did the fair itself raise?
questions.explanation: C明确fair为2400；A为差额；B混合总额；D错误再相加。

questions.prompt: What did the presenters do in the next programme?
options: Explain the error and state the correct figure.
Blame the parent who wrote in.
questions.explanation: A更正含原数、原因与正确数；B未避数；C没有指责家长；D没宣布新集市。

questions.prompt: What happened to the earlier recording?
options: It was sold to another school.
A correction note was placed beside it.
questions.explanation: D附更正说明保留记录；A为未采纳提议；B出售、C换音乐均无据。

questions.prompt: What new check did the team adopt?
options: Let only teachers speak on air.
Have another pupil check which event each total includes.
Use the largest number on every sheet.
questions.explanation: B第二学生确认总表条目归属；A未禁学生播音；C未停报道；D会再造错误。
